remainingUserRisks: [RELEASE_BLOCKER] RISK-001: Cannot authorize unattended/automatic production model updates safely against supply-chain tampering.
[RELEASE_BLOCKER] RISK-002: Unmeasured acoustic failure modes on regional Persian accents, noisy microphones, or spontaneous telephone speech.
[ACCEPTABLE_WITH_LIMITATION] RISK-003: Higher CPU cost on long live sessions compared to native stateful streaming checkpoints.
[HIGH_RISK] RISK-004: Browser-only local cold downloads are heavy and inference is CPU WASM bound.
[ACCEPTABLE_WITH_LIMITATION] RISK-005: Operational crash/recovery SLIs cannot yet confirm long-tail fleet reliability.
requiredFollowUpWork: Provision managed Ed25519 release signing keys and verify signed manifests before enabling automatic model updates (resolves RISK-001).
Assemble and adjudicate >=20 consented multi-speaker Persian real-world recordings to unlock statistically valid regression gating (resolves RISK-002).
Verify Browser Local WASM OPFS cold-load and test Native C++ / GPU runners on target hardware (mitigates RISK-004).
